description: The painting, Black Place I, by Georgia O'Keeffe was photographed sitting upon a chair in the Ghost Ranch patio. The photograph was enclosed in a letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Alfred Stieglitz dated 1944-07-06.
imageCaption: Black Place I, Ghost Ranch Patio. Letters to Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. © Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
title: Black Place I, Ghost Ranch Patio
